canonical_edition: Testimonium, FGrH #466: 3B:402–403. NQ: Test. test. 1: Inscr. Cret. 1.280. MENECLES Perieg. Cf. CALLICRATES-MENECLES Perieg. (1236).
sources_tested: Exact Canon/FGrH identifier; Brill New Jacoby historians catalogue (FGrH 466); DFHG Müller–Jacoby concordance; targeted searches for Inscriptiones Creticae I.280; Attalus inscription 112 comparison; local corpus and scans/scan_sources checks
open_text_result: No exact reusable Greek transcription of the Canon's Inscr. Cret. I.280 testimony was verified. Attalus 112 is a secondary English translation of IC 1.24.1, 1.8.11 and 2.3.2, not I.280, and is excluded as a non-matching witness.
scan_result: No item-level scan for Inscr. Cret. I.280 with an explicit reusable image licence was identified. Brill's modern BNJ FGrH 466 entry establishes identity only, not an open source file.
next_action: Map the Canon's abbreviated Inscr. Cret. I.280 citation to a stable Greek text/scan; then verify page or line concordance and an explicit image licence before any acquisition.
notes: BNJ catalogue identifies FGrH 466 as Menekles of Teos (not Menekles of Barka, FGrH 270). The related Callikrates–Menekles periegetic notice is separately cross-referenced by the Canon. Auxiliary comparison: https://www.attalus.org/docs/other/inscr_112.html; FGrH identity catalogue: https://scholarlyeditions.brill.com/bnjo/Historians/ . No provider OCR or image was used.
